title: Three Phases
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about a boss that changes as it is hurt. Big Bug paces a long tunnel and a star does not stop it. Hit it twice and it turns into a quicker orange bug, which is a different monster with its own picture and path. In the second level the last hit brings a tiny third one. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change when it changes.

box.back: A small explorer in a gold beanie has a pocketful of gold stars and two short levels to cross. Big Bug, round and very cheerful, paces a long tunnel through a brick wall, and it does not stay the same: hit it twice and it turns quicker, and the last hit brings a tiny new face. Read the signs, wait for it to come close, then open the game in Game-Maker and change when it changes.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A boss that changes is a chain of different monsters
Made to be copied and taken apart
